short.q: Describe what makes a rhythm syncopated.
short.model: Accents fall on weak beats or off the beat, often with notes tied across the beat.
points: accent on weak or off beat

short.model: Two main beats, each a dotted crotchet divided into three quavers: ONE-two-three TWO-two-three.

short.q: Describe the tempo changes: Allegro, then rallentando.
short.model: The music starts fast and lively, then gradually slows.

short.q: Why was the piano an advance on the harpsichord?
short.model: It could vary dynamics by touch, including gradual crescendo and diminuendo.

short.q: Define polyrhythm and name a tradition using it.
short.model: Several contrasting rhythms at once, as in West African drumming.
